privacyPolicy.intro: Integrated Energy Systems Ltd. ("PlayCube", "we") respects the privacy of your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, why, for how long we keep it, and what rights you have under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s1Body: Integrated Energy Systems Ltd., registered at Pleven, Western Industrial Zone, 1 Stroitel St., Bulgaria. For any questions about your personal data, contact us at ies@playcube.com or +359 889 57 19 51.
privacyPolicy.s2Body:
When you place an order: full name, email, phone, delivery address, city, postal code, and any order notes.
When you browse the site: anonymized visit data, only after consent, through analytics tools — see our Cookie Policy.
When you use the chat assistant: the content of the messages you send it, so we can answer your question.
privacyPolicy.s3Body: We process this data to: fulfil an order (performance of a contract, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); respond to inquiries via chat or the contact form (legitimate interest); analyze visitor behavior on the site (consent, Art. 6(1)(a)).
privacyPolicy.s4Body: Order data is retained for the period required under Bulgarian accounting and tax legislation. Chat correspondence is retained for up to 12 months. Analytics data is retained according to the relevant provider's settings — see our Cookie Policy.
privacyPolicy.s5Body: Your data may be processed by service providers who support us: Sanity (content management system), PostHog (analytics, EU region), Cloudflare (hosting and network security). We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacyPolicy.s6Body: Under GDPR you have the right to: access your data; rectify inaccurate data; erasure; restriction of processing; data portability; object to processing; withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, email us at ies@playcube.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP), www.cpdp.bg.
privacyPolicy.s7Body: The site uses cookies and similar technologies only after your explicit consent. Details are available in our Cookie Policy.
privacyPolicy.s8Body: The site is served entirely over HTTPS with TLS encryption. Access to administrative systems is restricted and protected by authentication.
privacyPolicy.s9Body: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be published on this page with a new "last updated" date.

cookiePolicy.intro: This policy explains what cookies and similar storage technologies the PlayCube site uses, and how you can manage your consent.
cookiePolicy.whatBody: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser. We use them — and your browser's local storage — only for the functions described below.
cookiePolicy.row2Purpose: Stores your cookie choice so the banner doesn't reappear on every visit. Not a cookie — a record in your browser's local storage.
cookiePolicy.row3Purpose: Set only after consent. Distinguishes visitors anonymously so we can analyze site usage.
cookiePolicy.row4Purpose: Anonymous visit counter with no cookies and no personal data. Doesn't require consent.
cookiePolicy.manageBody: On your first visit you see a banner letting you accept or decline analytics cookies. To change your choice later, clear your cookies and local storage for this site — the banner will reappear.
cookiePolicy.changesBody: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be published on this page with a new "last updated" date.

termsOfService.intro: These terms of service govern your use of the videligo.com website and the purchase of products from Integrated Energy Systems Ltd. ("PlayCube", "we"). By placing an order you confirm that you accept these terms.
termsOfService.s1Body: Integrated Energy Systems Ltd., registered at Pleven, Western Industrial Zone, 1 Stroitel St., Bulgaria. Email: ies@playcube.com. Phone: +359 889 57 19 51.
termsOfService.s2Body: All prices on the site are in euro (EUR) and include VAT unless stated otherwise. We reserve the right to change prices and stock availability without notice; changes do not affect already-confirmed orders.
termsOfService.s3Body: An order is considered placed once you complete the order form and press "Confirm order". The sales contract is considered concluded once one of our staff confirms the order by email or phone.
termsOfService.s4Body: Orders are currently processed by cash on delivery. Online card payment will be added in a future stage of the site's development.
termsOfService.s5Body: We deliver to the address you provide within Bulgaria. Delivery costs are agreed individually based on weight, volume, and location; delivery is free for orders over EUR 5,000. An estimated delivery time will be confirmed with your order.
termsOfService.s6Body: If you are a consumer under Bulgarian consumer-protection law, you have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days of receiving the goods, without giving a reason. To exercise this right, contact us at ies@playcube.com. Return shipping costs are borne by you unless agreed otherwise. The right of withdrawal does not apply to goods made to your individual specifications.
termsOfService.s7Body: All products come with a 24-month commercial warranty covering the unit's main components. This warranty does not affect the statutory guarantee of conformity under Bulgarian consumer-protection law.
termsOfService.s8Body: PlayCube is not liable for delay or non-performance caused by circumstances beyond our control (force majeure). Our liability for direct damages is limited to the value of the relevant order, unless otherwise required by law.
termsOfService.s9Body: These terms are governed by Bulgarian law. Any dispute will be resolved by mutual agreement, or failing that, by the competent Bulgarian court or the Commission for Consumer Protection (CPC), www.kzp.bg. You may also use the EU Online Dispute Resolution platform: ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.
termsOfService.s10Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Changes will be published on this page with a new "last updated" date and take effect from the date of publication.

about.introBody: INTEGRATED ENERGY SYSTEMS is a company specialised in delivering reliable power solutions for industrial facilities, hospitals, data centres and critical infrastructure across Bulgaria and the region. With over 10 years of experience and more than 10,000 kVA of installed capacity.
about.value1Body: Every unit that leaves our warehouse undergoes an 8-hour load test. Zero compromise on quality.
about.value2Body: Response within 4 hours for emergencies. Our own fleet of service vehicles across Bulgaria.
about.value3Body: We work with ISO 14001-certified manufacturers. We also offer gas solutions with a low carbon footprint.
about.value4Body: CE and ISO 8528 certified products. Full documentation and technical support for every installation.
about.ctaHeading: WE ARE READY TO WORK WITH YOU
about.milestone2003: Founded Integrated Energy Systems Ltd. in Sofia.
about.milestone2007: First contract with a hospital complex — 100+ healthcare installations.
about.milestone2012: Portfolio expanded with inverter and gas generators.
about.milestone2016: ISO 9001 certification and opening of a service hub in Plovdiv.
about.milestone2020: Maintenance digitisation — 24/7 remote monitoring of all units.
about.milestone2024: Over 500 active installations across 12 countries in the region.
